[[Captain Juno]] is the leader of the [[Luxon]] [[Turtle Clan]]. She is the eldest daughter of [[Kivros]], the previous Turtle Clan champion. When Juno was fourteen, she had an argument with Kivros during the [[Convocation]]. The next day, a large hunting party consisting of the two, [[Argo]], and many others set out, and only Juno and Argos returned alive. The two paired together to overthrow the previous Turtle Clan captain, where Juno has led since.<ref>[[Historian of Clans]]</ref>

Later in life, Juno had a daughter, [[Xandra]]. During a time of trouble, Juno sent Xandra to [[Ascalon]], officially as an ambassadorial tenure but many Luxons viewed it as exile.<ref>[[Xandra|Guild Wars: Eye of the North manual, Xandra's entry]]</ref> In the north, Xandra encountered [[Tanto the Grim]], who accused Juno of killing Kivros and that Xandra is fated to kill Juno.<ref>[[Haunted]]</ref>
